explanation:
Lane 4 verdict: INCONCLUSIVE for merge evidence, with no confirmed production-code defect in reviewed head d2cf18438debba60d87ce46ba6da68bca6f072b3 plus implementation-review.diff SHA256 8e5beba17e58c94b7db47611c9192227ea580a6480b46011be5cce6420c2fc4c; scoped design quality 8.5/10 and evidence readiness 7/10, after a hostile second pass and read-only inspection without executing validation.

Test-to-behavior map, with tests.rs relative to crates/honk-core/src/ebpf/real/routing: tests.rs:110-289 genuinely exercises domain-first short-circuiting, separate destination/source/MAC lookups before later scalar failures, cross-helper non-NULL reuse, positive/negative bit selection, alternating inputs and generation/domain-final changes, with the retained ready=1 mutant rejected at A1 in cache-mutation-rejection.log:9-11; tests.rs:292-359 exercises IPv6 host-to-ancestor destination/source bitmap reuse and delayed first source lookup on the /0 path, detecting stale predicate-result caching or corrupted retained pointers; tests.rs:363-427 exercises zero-bitmap versus NULL decisions and destination reuse, but its positive destination failure skips source/MAC, which are each reached only once in the negative rule; tests.rs:429-475 distinguishes absent MAC from a present all-zero MAC and reuses synthetic absent-MAC NULL, not helper-returned MAC-map-miss NULL; tests.rs:478-524 checks invalid families 0/3 and negation, with repeated destination synthetic NULL but only one reached source condition; tests.rs:645-738 checks bits 0/31/32/63/64/255 and the capacity rejection boundary, although source/MAC are reached only in the winning destination rule rather than repeatedly; tests.rs:818-847 sends a real map-fill failure through publication and checks preserved active hit/miss decisions, whereas tests.rs:855-875 invokes the loader directly, so its repeated active-state assertions provide little additional CSE or publication-rollback evidence; unchanged tests.rs:529-581 supplies 468 hand-authored golden decision comparisons across four dial modes, including additional source-NULL reuse, while tests.rs:586-640 remains a single-use large-map control rather than cache-reuse coverage.

Evidence/fixes: host-routing-gate-dw-ready.log:6-16 and linux612-routing.log:2-12 support the recorded 7/7 real routing passes, unlike the explicitly rejected packed-ready experiment at linux612-packed-ready-rejection.log:1222-1233; root_probe.rs:8-29 installs the baseline emitter against generation-owned maps and all real targets, root_probe.rs:73-88 checks independent complete expected decisions before 15 alternating AB/BA samples after two warmups at repeat=20000, and root-paired-results.json supports only fixed-hot-input canonical root/slot timings—such as the IPv4 256-rule tail median 8082 ns versus 196 ns—with flat 0/1 controls, not full traffic, randomized/cold behavior, source/MAC performance or comparable loader costs; a confirmed evidence-only defect outside the four-file patch was reported to Main and CseMeasurements at measure.py:855, where dividing BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN duration by repeat again understates ns/evaluation because Linux already averages it in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/torvalds/linux/v6.12/net/bpf/test_run.c, and the owner acknowledged the correction without this review claiming it completed; retain the useful semantic tests, avoid crediting correlated all-category bitmap layouts as independent anti-alias tests or direct-loader checks as publication rollback, close repeated source/MAC NULL/zero and lookup-budget evidence with the mixed dynamic probe, and leave dynamic-count results, x86/ARM labs and netns/full gates explicitly pending rather than reporting their absence as a code bug.
